title: 495. Evita: The Rise of General Perón (Part 2)

sentences.en: Here in the confusion of the streets, where a new sense of purpose is coming to be born.
sentences.zh: 这里是喧嚣混乱的街道，一个新的使命感正孕育而生。

sentences.en: Here among the anonymous mass of working, suffering, thinking, silent people.
sentences.zh: 这里是千千万万默默无闻、辛勤劳作、历经苦难、在思考中保持沉默的人们。

sentences.en: Here in the midst of exhaustion and hope, justice and mockery.
sentences.zh: 这里交织着精疲力竭与满怀希望，交织着正义与嘲弄。

sentences.en: Here in this shapeless mass, the driving force of a capital city, nerve center and engine of a great American country.
sentences.zh: 这里汇聚了庞杂喧嚣的民众，他们是一座首都的驱动力，是一个伟大美洲国家的核心枢纽与强劲引擎。

sentences.en: Here she is.
sentences.zh: 她来了。

sentences.en: The woman.
sentences.zh: 这位女性。

sentences.en: So that was the introduction to a radio program called, brilliantly,
sentences.zh: 这段充满才华的导语，出自一档广播节目，其名字极其宏大：

sentences.en: The Soldiers' Revolution Will Be the Revolution of the Argentine People.
sentences.zh: 《士兵革命将是阿根廷人民的革命》。

sentences.en: Very Radio 4 title there.
sentences.zh: 非常有 BBC 第四台风格的名字。

sentences.en: Great title.
sentences.zh: 好名字。

sentences.en: I'd tune in.
sentences.zh: 我会收听的。

sentences.en: And that was broadcast on Argentine radio, obviously, on the 14th of August, 1944.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，这档节目于 1944 年 8 月 14 日在阿根廷广播电台播出。

sentences.en: And the program was kind of dramatizing instances of poverty out in the reaches of Argentina, so it will be listing TB statistics and illiteracy and undernourishment.
sentences.zh: 节目内容大体上是将阿根廷偏远地区的贫困状况戏剧化，其中列举了肺结核发病率、文盲率以及营养不良等数据。

sentences.en: And the woman in this was played by Ava Duarte, who is the subject of our ongoing series, better known as Evita, and in due course to become Ava Perron.
sentences.zh: 节目中的女性由玛丽亚·埃娃·杜阿尔特饰演，也就是我们系列节目持续关注的主角，也就是后人熟知的埃维塔，不久后将成为埃娃·庇隆。

sentences.en: And in the course of this radio program that is broadcast, she speaks at the very end of the program.
sentences.zh: 在这档播出的广播节目接近尾声时，她发表了一段讲话。

sentences.en: And Ava Duarte says,
sentences.zh: 埃娃·杜阿尔特说道：

sentences.en: The revolution was made for exploited workers.
sentences.zh: 革命是为受剥削的工人而发生的。

sentences.en: It was made because of the fraud of dishonest politicians and because the country was bankrupt of feeling at the verge of suicide.
sentences.zh: 它的发生是因为无良政客的欺诈，是因为这个国家丧失了情感，濒临绝望的边缘。

sentences.en: There was one man who could bring dignity to the notion of work, a soldier of the people who could feel the flame of social justice.
sentences.zh: 曾有一人赋予了劳动以尊严，他是人民的战士，感受得到社会正义的炽热火焰。

sentences.en: It was he who decisively helped the people's revolution.
sentences.zh: 正是他，坚定不移地协助了人民的革命。

sentences.en: Now, the name of this man is not given, but Dominic, I think it's fairly clear who is being alluded to.
sentences.zh: 节目中并未提及此人的姓名，但多米尼克，我觉得大家都很清楚暗指的是谁。

sentences.en: And that person is Colonel Juan Domingo Perron, the most significant political figure in Argentina in 1944.
sentences.zh: 这个人就是胡安·多明戈·庇隆上校，1944 年阿根廷政坛最具影响力的人物。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And a person with whom, by the time Ava is voicing that, she is having an affair.
sentences.zh: 当埃娃说出这番话时，她与此人已经陷入了爱河。

sentences.en: And the relationship between Ava and Perron is at the heart of this extraordinary story.
sentences.zh: 埃娃与庇隆之间的关系，正是这个非凡故事的核心。

sentences.en: It is indeed, Tom.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，汤姆。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: At the point when they do that, she does that broadcast, their relationship is about eight months old.
sentences.zh: 当他们这么做——也就是她进行那次广播时，两人的关系大约才维持了八个月。

sentences.en: They had met at the beginning of 1944.
sentences.zh: 他们于 1944 年年初相识。

sentences.en: Now, if you listened to the last episode, you will remember that she moved from the endless rural hinterland of the Pampa to Buenos Aires to seek her fortune,
sentences.zh: 如果你听过上一集，你就会记得她从潘帕斯草原一望无际的偏远腹地搬到了布宜诺斯艾利斯，去寻找她的财富，

sentences.en: to make her career in radio and in show business.
sentences.zh: 去在广播界和演艺圈开创自己的事业。

sentences.en: And then actually, she hasn't done too badly because after a lot of struggle and poverty and kind of cast and couch misery, by the beginning of 1944,
sentences.zh: 事实上，她混得还算不错，因为在经历了无数的挣扎、贫困以及潜规则的痛苦之后，到 1944 年初，

sentences.en: she is an established radio actress, isn't she, Tom?
sentences.zh: 她已经是一位成名的广播剧女演员了，对吧，汤姆？

sentences.en: We were talking about her last time in all these soap operas.
sentences.zh: 我们上一次还讨论过她参演的那些肥皂剧。

sentences.en: She is.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we were talking about how when she began, she was playing the part of housemaids and secretaries and so on.
sentences.zh: 我们还讨论过她刚出道时，扮演的都是女佣和秘书之类的小角色。

sentences.en: But by this time, she's starting to play queens.
sentences.zh: 但到了这个时候，她开始扮演女王了。

sentences.en: She is indeed.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So she gets cast to play the part of various significant female figures from history.
sentences.zh: 因此她被选中去扮演历史上各个重要的女性人物。

sentences.en: So heroines of history, it's called.
sentences.zh: 也就是所谓的历史上的女英雄。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's a series.
sentences.zh: 这是一个系列。

sentences.en: And among them is Elizabeth I.
sentences.zh: 其中包括伊丽莎白一世。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Catherine the Great.
sentences.zh: 叶卡捷琳娜大帝。

sentences.en: Lady Hamilton.
sentences.zh: 汉密尔顿夫人。

sentences.en: So Nelson's lover.
sentences.zh: 也就是纳尔逊的情人。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Mrs. Chiang Kai-shek.
sentences.zh: 蒋介石夫人。

sentences.en: So all the stars of history.
sentences.zh: 总之都是历史上的大明星。

sentences.en: But it's a sign that, you know, she's kind of made it, hasn't she?
sentences.zh: 但这表明，你知道的，她算是成功出圈了，对吧？

sentences.en: So at least in the terms of radio stars, she's become acting royalty.
sentences.zh: 至少在广播界，她已经成了表演界的皇室成员。

sentences.en: She has.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's an interesting one, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 这是一个很有趣的现象，不是吗？

sentences.en: Because she's playing heroines of history, these strong women.
sentences.zh: 因为她扮演的是历史上的女英雄，这些坚强的女性。

sentences.en: And of course, she's remembered herself as a strong woman.
sentences.zh: 当然，她自己也被人们铭记为一个坚强的女性。

sentences.en: But as that reading that you did, the woman, lots of our listeners, particularly if they are women, will say, oh, how disappointing that actually that program,
sentences.zh: 但正如你刚才朗读的那段关于“女性”的内容，我们的许多听众——尤其是女性听众——会说，太令人失望了，原来在那个节目里，

sentences.en: the woman is merely the handmaiden of the man, of Perron.
sentences.zh: 女性仅仅是男性的附庸，是庇隆的婢女。

sentences.en: And that sort of tension lies at the heart of Evita's story, that on the one hand, she is the personification of the strong woman, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 这种张力正是埃维塔故事的核心：一方面，我想她可以说是坚强女性的化身。

sentences.en: But as we will see, everything is, for her, is about Perron.
sentences.zh: 但正如我们将要看到的，对她而言，一切都是为了庇隆。

sentences.en: You know, her entire political persona, as bizarre as it may sound, is based on a kind of self-abnegation,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她整个政治形象，听起来可能有些离奇，但却是建立在一种自我牺牲的基础之上的，

sentences.en: being wrapped up with this army officer who becomes the most significant politician, arguably, in Argentina's history.
sentences.zh: 她与这位军官紧密捆绑在一起，而这位军官后来成为了阿根廷历史上可以说是最具影响力的政治家。

sentences.en: To do the heroines of history, she actually had to get permission to do that.
sentences.zh: 为了饰演历史上的女英雄，她实际上必须获得批准。

sentences.en: She had to go to see army officers.
sentences.zh: 她不得不去拜访军官。

sentences.en: And the reason for that is that in the summer of 1943, there had been a military coup in Argentina.
sentences.zh: 原因是在 1943 年夏天，阿根廷发生了一场军事政变。

sentences.en: This is not something that had massively impinged on her, or there's no sense that she had cared about it, or that she was even particularly political.
sentences.zh: 这件事并没有对她产生巨大的冲击，也没有迹象表明她曾在乎过，或者她对政治有多大兴趣。

sentences.en: But there has been this reasonably bloodless military coup.
sentences.zh: 但确实发生了一场相当平和的军事政变。

sentences.en: Argentina, at this point, I mean, is wealthy and successful.
sentences.zh: 当时的阿根廷，我的意思是，富裕且成功。

sentences.en: But is it a functioning democracy?
sentences.zh: 但这算是一个正常运转的民主国家吗？

sentences.en: Are coups too a penny?
sentences.zh: 政变在这里是不是司空见惯？

sentences.en: Is this unusual?
sentences.zh: 这难道不寻常吗？

sentences.en: It's politics for a bit of a mess.
sentences.zh: 政坛变得有点一团糟。

sentences.en: I think that's, you can basically take that as read at every given moment of this entire series.
sentences.zh: 我想你可以把这一点当成贯穿整个系列每一个环节的不变事实。

sentences.en: That is, politics are a bit chaotic and a bit of a mess.
sentences.zh: 那就是，政坛总是有些混乱，有些一团糟。

sentences.en: So there had been a radical president called Irigoyen in 1930 who'd been toppled.
sentences.zh: 1930 年，曾有一位名叫伊里戈扬的激进派总统被推翻。

sentences.en: And then in the 1930s, they call it in Argentina the infamous decade.
sentences.zh: 然后在 20 世纪 30 年代，在阿根廷被称为臭名昭著的十年。

sentences.en: I mean, actually, by the standards of the 1930s, Argentina's really not that infamous.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，以 30 年代的标准来看，阿根廷其实也没那么臭名昭著。

sentences.en: Yeah, not bad.
sentences.zh: 是的，还过得去。

sentences.en: Or indeed the 70s in Argentina, I guess.
sentences.zh: 或者说，比起阿根廷的 70 年代，我想是的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: But they had a succession of very corrupt, kind of oligarchic.
sentences.zh: 但他们经历了一连串非常腐败的、某种寡头统治。

sentences.en: There's a lot of talk about this, the oligarchy.
sentences.zh: 关于这一点，也就是寡头政治，有很多讨论。

sentences.en: And the oligarchy are the big conservative landowners.
sentences.zh: 寡头就是那些拥有大量土地的保守派地主。

sentences.en: So they had run Argentine politics throughout the 1930s.
sentences.zh: 他们在整个 20 世纪 30 年代一直把持着阿根廷政坛。

sentences.en: And actually, people were getting a bit sick of them by the 1940s, because they say, these people just sew everything up for their own interests.
sentences.zh: 事实上，到了 40 年代，人们对他们已经有些厌烦了，因为大家觉得，这些人把一切利益都垄断在自己手里。

sentences.en: They're actually total puppets.
sentences.zh: 他们其实完全就是傀儡。

sentences.en: Just hanging out at Harrods, playing polo, all that.
sentences.zh: 成天在哈罗德百货闲逛，打马球，诸如此类。

sentences.en: Yeah, British capital.
sentences.zh: 是的，英国资本。

sentences.en: And there's a group of young military officers in 1943 who had said, enough.
sentences.zh: 1943 年，有一群年轻军官站出来说：够了。

sentences.en: Argentina can do better than these sort of people in tweed suits talking about the chukka and drinking port or whatever they're doing.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷完全可以比这些穿着花呢西装、谈论着马球比赛、喝着波特酒或干着其他什么事的家伙做得更好。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're better than this.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们比他们强。

sentences.en: And they pointed out, you know, most of our economy is actually owned by British firMs.
sentences.zh: 他们指出，你知道的，我们的大部分经济实际上都被英国公司所掌控。

sentences.en: All our railways are owned by the British.
sentences.zh: 我们所有的铁路都归英国人所有。

sentences.en: American companies own the whole automotive.
sentences.zh: 美国公司则垄断了整个汽车制造业。

sentences.en: This is wrong.
sentences.zh: 这大错特错。

sentences.en: Argentina should run its own companies.
sentences.zh: 阿根廷应该经营自己的企业。

sentences.en: We're not just a province, basically, of the British Empire.
sentences.zh: 我们基本上不只是大英帝国的某个省份。

sentences.en: And so they had swept away the existing government in 1943.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们在 1943 年推翻了现政权。

sentences.en: And the big star of that group of officers is this guy, Juan Perron.
sentences.zh: 而这群军官中最耀眼的明星就是这个人，胡安·庇隆。

sentences.en: So I know, Tom, you love that film, Evita.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，我知道你很喜欢那部电影《贝隆夫人》。

sentences.en: And in the film, he's played by Jonathan Price, who is a very distinguished actor.
sentences.zh: 在电影中，他由乔纳森·普雷斯饰演，这是一位非常杰出的演员。

sentences.en: He's just not Juan Perron.
sentences.zh: 他只是长得不像胡安·庇隆。

sentences.en: I like Jonathan Price's hair in the film.
sentences.zh: 我挺喜欢乔纳森·普雷斯在片中的发型。

sentences.en: It looks completely artificial.
sentences.zh: 看起来完全是假的。

sentences.en: And I think that that is true to Juan Perron's tonsorial style.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这倒是挺符合胡安·庇隆的发型风格的。

sentences.en: He's a big burly man, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 他是个身材魁梧的大块头，对吧？

sentences.en: You were comparing him to Dominic WeSt.
sentences.zh: 你曾把他比作多米尼克·韦斯特。

sentences.en: And I think that's a really good shout.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这个比喻真的很贴切。

sentences.en: A big shout out to Dominic West, who listens to The Rest is History.
sentences.zh: 向收听《历史的余烬》（The Rest is History）的多米尼克·韦斯特致敬。

sentences.en: Nice to have you with us.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能加入我们。

sentences.en: You should play Juan Perron if there is ever a Netflix drama about Perron.
sentences.zh: 如果以后有关于庇隆的 Netflix 剧集，你应该去演胡安·庇隆。

sentences.en: So Perron is much older than Ava.
sentences.zh: 庇隆比埃娃大很多。

sentences.en: He was born in 1895.
sentences.zh: 他出生于 1895 年。

sentences.en: So he's almost 20 years older.
sentences.zh: 所以他大将近 20 岁。

sentences.en: In fact, he is 20 years older.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他确实大 20 岁。

sentences.en: He was the son of a guy who was like a tenant farmer, basically.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲基本上是个佃农。

sentences.en: He's born in Buenos Aires province in the middle of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 他出生在布宜诺斯艾利斯省一个人迹罕至的地方。

sentences.en: His father goes off to Patagonia.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲去了巴塔哥尼亚。

sentences.en: Juan is sent off to school in Buenos Aires, boarding school.
sentences.zh: 小胡安被送到布宜诺斯艾利斯的一所寄宿学校上学。

sentences.en: He's a very sporty boy.
sentences.zh: 他是一个非常热爱运动的男孩。

sentences.en: He's a big person.
sentences.zh: 他个子很大。

sentences.en: Except Dominic.
sentences.zh: 除了多米尼克。

sentences.en: Intriguingly, he's keen on kind of individual sports.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，他热衷于个人运动。

sentences.en: But shockingly for an Argentine, he doesn't like football.
sentences.zh: 但对阿根廷人来说令人震惊的是，他不喜欢足球。

sentences.en: Doesn't really like team sports.
sentences.zh: 他其实不太喜欢团队运动。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: And I don't know whether there's some kind of psychological cast can be read into that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这其中是否能解读出某种心理特质。

sentences.en: He's not a team player.
sentences.zh: 他不是一个具有团队精神的人。

sentences.en: Well, do you know what he loves?
sentences.zh: 你知道他最喜欢什么吗？

sentences.en: It's fencing.
sentences.zh: 是击剑。

sentences.en: And of course, Oswald Mosley is a champion fencer.
sentences.zh: 当然，奥斯瓦尔德·莫斯利也是一名击剑冠军。

sentences.en: I mean, that is a film waiting to be written.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个等待被拍成电影的题材。

sentences.en: The Oswald Mosley-Juan Perron fencing conteSt.
sentences.zh: 奥斯瓦尔德·莫斯利与胡安·庇隆的击剑对决。

sentences.en: But Dominic, I think that Perron, just to stick up for him, is a much more attractive figure than Mosley.
sentences.zh: 但多米尼克，为了帮庇隆说句公道话，我觉得他比莫斯利更有魅力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: He's kind of fun, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 他挺有趣的，不是吗？

sentences.en: He's amusing.
sentences.zh: 他很逗趣。

sentences.en: People like him in a way that Mosley is kind of more fascist leader in waiting.
sentences.zh: 人们喜欢他，而莫斯利则更像是一个随时准备上台的法西斯领袖。

sentences.en: And Perron is not really a fasciSt.
sentences.zh: 庇隆其实不是个法西斯分子。

sentences.en: Perron is not a cad in the way that Mosley's get.
sentences.zh: 庇隆不像莫斯利那样是个无赖。

sentences.en: Although Perron is guilty later on of some quite dubious behavior.
sentences.zh: 尽管庇隆后来确实有一些相当可疑的行为。

sentences.en: Perron is not a kind of out-and-out bounder.
sentences.zh: 但庇隆算不上那种彻头彻尾的流氓。

sentences.en: So from the point when he goes into the military academy, everybody says to Perron, he's a really big man.
sentences.zh: 所以，从他进入军事学院的那天起，所有人都说庇隆是个大人物。

sentences.en: He's a big man in the barracks.
sentences.zh: 他在军营里是个大人物。

sentences.en: He's popular with the other guys.
sentences.zh: 他在其他伙伴中很受欢迎。

sentences.en: Like, he's more than six feet tall.
sentences.zh: 比如，他的身高超过六英尺。

sentences.en: As you said, Tom, he's handsome and he's kind of burly.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，汤姆，他很英俊，而且身材魁梧。

sentences.en: But he's a good laugh.
sentences.zh: 但他很爱笑，很有幽默感。

sentences.en: He's very charming.
sentences.zh: 他非常有魅力。

sentences.en: He's easygoing.
sentences.zh: 他随和友善。

sentences.en: You know, he's not prickly.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他并不难相处。

sentences.en: He's not ridiculously proud.
sentences.zh: 他并不荒谬地自傲。

sentences.en: He's not particularly aggressive.
sentences.zh: 他并不特别具有攻击性。

sentences.zh: 只有一个个不同的庇隆。

sentences.zh: 我觉得可以公正地说，正如伊娃一样，庇隆也在扮演一个角色。

sentences.en: And he's brilliant at improvising as well.
sentences.zh: 而且他极其擅长即兴发挥。

sentences.zh: 同样，这对于解释他如何利用与伊娃的婚姻也至关重要。

sentences.zh: 他真的非常非常擅长政治。

sentences.zh: 他主动要求并获得了劳工部，这听起来是一个极其没有吸引力的部门。

sentences.en: But he is smart.
sentences.zh: 但他很聪明。

sentences.en: It's not a braid-friendly ministry, is it?
sentences.zh: 这不是一个适合戴饰带的部门，对吧？

sentences.zh: 多久就说不准了。

sentences.zh: 你知道，他正在工人阶级中建立这个权力基础。

sentences.zh: 他非常像罗马共和国晚期政治中的克洛狄乌斯。

sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: The tribune who establishes the bread doll in Rome.
sentences.zh: 那个在罗马设立粮食配给的保民官。

sentences.en: And he fashions paramilitaries out of where previously there had been nothing but kind of inchoate chaos.
sentences.zh: 他在原本只有一片无序混乱的地方，建立起了准军事组织。

sentences.en: So there's maybe a faint element of that, perhaps.
sentences.zh: 所以也许其中有那么一点微弱的相似之处吧。

sentences.en: The descamisados of the Roman Republic.
sentences.zh: 罗马共和国的无衫者。

sentences.en: Exactly so.
sentences.zh: 完全正是如此。

sentences.en: So Perron, as you said, he's a great improviser, a great opportuniSt.
sentences.zh: 所以庇隆，正如你所说，他是一个伟大的即兴发挥者，一个极具机会主义的人。

sentences.en: In January 1944, there's a terrible earthquake in the city of San Juan, kills at least 10,000 people.
sentences.zh: 1944年1月，圣胡安市发生了一场可怕的地震，造成至少1万人死亡。

sentences.en: And Perron says to the other people in the government, I've got this, you know, I will handle this.
sentences.zh: 庇隆对政府里其他人说，这事交给我，你知道的，我会处理好的。

sentences.en: Again, the great improviser.
sentences.zh: 再次展现了伟大的即兴能力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, not letting a disaster go to waste.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，不浪费任何一场灾难。

sentences.en: And Perron, he's all over the relief efforts and he's sending out clothes and money and all this.
sentences.zh: 庇隆全面介入了救援工作，分发衣物、金钱和各种物资。

sentences.en: But he's got a brilliant wheeze and his wheezes will get all the big actors and actresses and singers and stuff.
sentences.zh: 但他有一个绝妙的主意，他的点子能把所有大牌演员、女演员和歌手都调动起来。

sentences.en: On a Saturday, they will go through the center of Buenos Aires with people from the military government.
sentences.zh: 在周六，他们会和军政府的人一起走过布宜诺斯艾利斯的中心。

sentences.en: Each one will have a money box.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会拿着一个募捐箱。

sentences.en: I mean, imagine the scene, all these actors and people giving.
sentences.zh: 我的天，想象一下那个场景，所有这些演员和人们都在捐款。

sentences.en: I mean, that's brilliant.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这太妙了。

sentences.en: If that happened in London, what an amazing thing that would be.
sentences.zh: 如果这发生在伦敦，那该是多么惊人的景象啊。

sentences.en: But this is why Ava and Perron are such perfect subjects for a kind of West End musical.
sentences.zh: 但这就是为什么伊娃和庇隆是西区音乐剧的完美题材。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, the kind of, you know, the stars in West End musicals would go out and do this kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那种，你知道的，西区音乐剧的明星们会走上街头做这种事。

sentences.en: You know, they'd wear ribbons.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们会佩戴缎带。

sentences.zh: 本尼迪克特·康伯巴奇。

sentences.en: I can see him doing it.
sentences.zh: 我能想象他做这件事的样子。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，完全如此。

sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.zh: 这种结合太绝了。

sentences.zh: 当时的伊娃·杜亚尔特无疑也去了现场。

sentences.zh: 她很喜欢这种场合。

sentences.zh: 她绝对去了。

sentences.zh: 庇隆后来声称，这就是他们第一次见面的时候。

sentences.zh: 大多数人认为这根本不对。

sentences.zh: 她当时根本没给他留下什么印象。

sentences.zh: 马拉多纳的婚宴就是在那办的。

sentences.zh: 而且就在我们录音的这周，哈维尔·米莱在那里举行了新书发布会，他和他的摇滚乐队一起唱歌，还饶舌唱了共产主义。

sentences.en: So, great scenes.
sentences.zh: 所以，场面非常盛大。

sentences.zh: 但他没有玩杂耍……

sentences.en: No, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.zh: 不管怎样，所以在月神公园，他们举办了一场盛大的晚会。

sentences.zh: 庇隆去了。

sentences.zh: 伊娃和她的一个朋友一起去了。

sentences.zh: 她盛装打扮。

sentences.en: She clearly has her eye on him.
sentences.zh: 她显然把目光投向了他。

sentences.zh: 他比她大得多，但不巧的是他身上长了皮疹。

sentences.zh: 你看到这个了吗？

sentences.en: No, I've missed that.
sentences.zh: 没，我没注意到。

sentences.zh: 那是很严重的皮疹。

sentences.zh: 所以，他患有牛皮癣。

sentences.zh: 因此，他总是涂抹大量的面霜和粉底来遮盖皮疹。

sentences.zh: 实际上，这意味着他拍出来的照片效果极其惊艳。

sentences.zh: 因为他看起来油光发亮的或者别的什么原因。

sentences.zh: 我不知道具体是为什么。

sentences.zh: 因为他的皮疹。

sentences.en: Anyway, he looks brilliant.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，他看起来帅极了。

sentences.en: Rash or no rash.
sentences.zh: 有没有皮疹都一样。

sentences.en: This is a famous bit in the musical where...
sentences.zh: 这是音乐剧里的一个著名桥段，在那里……

sentences.zh: 然后他们一起唱，久仰大名。

sentences.en: And it's off.
sentences.zh: 就这样开始了。

sentences.zh: 他以前不太可能听说过她。

sentences.zh: 好了，这就是我想问的。

sentences.zh: 他会听说过她吗？

sentences.zh: 那时候她已经那么出名了吗？

sentences.en: I think highly unlikely.
sentences.zh: 我觉得可能性极低。

sentences.zh: 你听说过很多广播剧女演员吗？

sentences.zh: 没有，但如果我遇到《阿切尔一家》里的人，我大概能听出他们的声音。

sentences.en: Felicity Jones, is it?
sentences.zh: 菲丽希缇·琼斯，对吧？

sentences.zh: 她演过星球大战电影《侠盗一号》。

sentences.zh: 在我看来，那是最好的一部星战电影。

sentences.en: I've never heard of her.
sentences.zh: 我从没听说过她。

sentences.en: Well, she's very famous, Tom.
sentences.zh: 好吧，她非常有名，汤姆。

sentences.en: She's like Oscar-nominated actress.
sentences.zh: 她可是获得过奥斯卡提名的女演员。

sentences.en: I've never heard of her.
sentences.zh: 我从没听说过她。

sentences.en: We talked about her schooled on a previous...

sentences.zh: 聊过吗？

sentences.en: Of course we did.
sentences.zh: 我们当然聊过。

sentences.en: We talked about her private school on a previous podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们在之前的播客里聊过她的私立学校。

sentences.en: Very restless history.
sentences.zh: 一段非常动荡的历史。

sentences.en: If she'd met the future dictator of Britain at a gala, that would...
sentences.zh: 如果她在一次晚会上遇到了未来的英国独裁者，那将会……

sentences.en: Anyway, listen, this is spiralling on.
sentences.zh: 总之，听着，这话题越扯越远了。

sentences.en: It's a terrible tangent.
sentences.zh: 跑题跑得太离谱了。

sentences.en: Anyway, they meet.
sentences.zh: 不管怎样，他们见面了。

sentences.en: And Ava is basically...
sentences.zh: 而且伊娃基本上……

sentences.en: She is the one who is taking the lead.
sentences.zh: 她是占据主导地位的那个人。

sentences.zh: 而且看过音乐剧的人都知道，庇隆当时已经有一个女朋友了，对吧？

sentences.zh: 庇隆和一个人住在一起，他还把这个人介绍给所有人。

sentences.en: This is a bad sign with Perron.
sentences.zh: 这在庇隆身上可不是什么好兆头。

sentences.zh: 事实上，在这一季的最后几集里情况会更糟糕。

sentences.zh: 而且绝妙的是，他管她叫“女庇隆”，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And it's unclear whether that's because she eats so much or because she has a kind of overhanging lip.

sentences.zh: 她有轻微的上颌前突。

sentences.en: Maria Ines.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚·伊内斯。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, I think she's just an extremely and inappropriately young girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，我觉得她只是一个极其年轻且不太合适的女朋友。

sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.zh: 把她所有的行李都扔了出去。

sentences.zh: 她甚至雇了一辆卡车，去把佩隆夫人的所有物品都拿走，塞进卡车里，对她说，你出局了。

sentences.en: Get back to Mendoza.
sentences.zh: 回门多萨去吧。

sentences.en: So that is the end, unfortunately.
sentences.zh: 所以，一切就这样结束了，不幸的是。

sentences.en: Perron gets home after a hard day at the office, you know, talking to union leaders.
sentences.zh: 佩隆结束了一天繁重的工作回家，你知道的，他一直在跟工会领袖谈话。

sentences.en: The Perrona has vanished.
sentences.zh: 结果贝隆夫人已经消失了。

sentences.zh: 有传言说，伊娃其实自己买了一些东西，还开始拆包，就像搬进公寓一样。

sentences.zh: 但我觉得，我的意思是，这挺有趣的，对吧？

sentences.zh: 但它确实符合他们两人性格中的某些特质。

sentences.en: Five days after this 17th of October, which now will become the annual feast day of Peronism, which they celebrate with these huge rallies.
sentences.zh: 在10月17日之后的第五天，这一天后来成了庇隆主义的年度节日，他们会通过举行盛大的集会来庆祝。

sentences.en: Do you think the fact that Eva comes to be identified with this day and with the Descamisados,
sentences.zh: 你认为埃瓦后来开始与这一天以及“无裤党”联系在一起，

sentences.en: does she come to believe it?
sentences.zh: 她自己也开始相信这一点了吗？

sentences.en: Is that a kind of a part of what inspires her to feel that she's been mystically joined with them?
sentences.zh: 这是否也是促使她觉得自己与他们神秘地融为一体的一部分原因？

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: I totally think so, Tom.
sentences.zh: 我完全这么认为，汤姆。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think when you look at all her rhetoric in what follows, the constant invocation of the Descamisados, the belief that she is the mystical link between them and Peron.
sentences.zh: 我认为，当你审视她此后所有的言论时，会发现她不断提及“无裤党”，坚信自己是他们与庇隆之间的神秘纽带。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The bridge.
sentences.zh: 那座桥梁。

sentences.en: I don't think that there might be a tiny sliver of her that is cynical about it, but I don't really think there is.
sentences.zh: 我不认为她内心哪怕有一丝一毫对此感到虚伪，我觉得根本没有。

sentences.en: I think she absolutely believes it.
sentences.zh: 我认为她是发自内心地深信不疑。

sentences.en: No, I don't think she's cynical at all.
sentences.zh: 不，我觉得她一点也不虚伪。

sentences.en: I mean, I think Peron is quite cynical, but I think Eva believes everything.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得庇隆可能相当虚伪，但埃瓦对一切深信不疑。

sentences.en: She believes it in the way that Ronald Reagan believed those stories he would tell about the old America and, you know, great actors believe the part they play.
sentences.zh: 她相信这一切，就像罗纳德·里根相信他那些关于美国老古董的故事一样，你知道的，伟大的演员总是相信自己扮演的角色。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, she's not a great actor, but on the public stage of Argentina, she plays the greatest role.
sentences.zh: 好吧，她或许不是个伟大的演员，但在阿根廷的公共舞台上，她扮演了最重要的角色。

sentences.en: Of all.
sentences.zh: 最伟大的一個。

sentences.en: Oh, very good.
sentences.zh: 哦，说得太好了。

sentences.en: So five days after this big business, they get married.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一大堆事情发生的五天后，他们结婚了。

sentences.en: They get married in their apartment.
sentences.zh: 他们在公寓里结婚了。

sentences.en: It is a brief civil ceremony and almost everything about it is false, meretricious.
sentences.zh: 这是一场简短的民事婚礼，几乎所有细节都是虚假且华而不实的。

sentences.en: So they claim they got married in Hunin, her hometown, which they didn't.
sentences.zh: 比如他们声称是在她的家乡胡宁结婚的，但并没有。

sentences.en: But she never goes back there, does she?
sentences.zh: 但她再也没有回去过，对吧？

sentences.en: She doesn't go back.
sentences.zh: 她没有回去。

sentences.en: The date of birth is wrong and her name is wrong.
sentences.zh: 她的出生日期是错的，名字也是错的。

sentences.en: She puts her real age as 23 rather than 26.
sentences.zh: 她把自己的真实年龄填成了23岁，而不是26岁。

sentences.en: She says she was born in 1922 instead of 1919 and she puts her name as Duarte.
sentences.zh: 她说自己出生于1922年而不是1919年，还将姓氏填成了杜阿尔特。

sentences.en: And there is no doubt why she does this.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问她为什么要这么做。

sentences.en: It's not so that she can look younger.
sentences.zh: 不是为了让自己看起来更年轻。

sentences.en: She's not vain about that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 她在这种事情上并不虚荣。

sentences.en: It is actually so that she can claim her father's surname rather than admit her illegitimacy.
sentences.zh: 实际上是为了能够冠上父亲的姓氏，而不是承认自己私生女的身份。

sentences.en: And a few months later, somebody, we don't know who, but we can guess, goes to Los Tollos, the place where she had been born.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，有人——我们不知道是谁，但大概能猜到——去了她出生的那个地方洛斯托洛斯。

sentences.en: They find the registry.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了户籍档案。

sentences.en: They tear out her birth certificate.
sentences.zh: 他们撕掉了她的出生证明。

sentences.en: They replace it with a false date and a false name, giving her the name of Duarte.
sentences.zh: 用虚假的日期和虚假的名字取而代之，将她的姓氏改成了杜阿尔特。

sentences.en: She never admitted to Perón.
sentences.zh: 她从未向庇隆坦白过。

sentences.en: She never told him that she had been born under a different name.
sentences.zh: 她从未告诉过他自己出生时用的是另一个名字。

sentences.en: I mean, absolutely extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这简直不可思议。

sentences.en: And yet the strange thing about that is that it's precisely the fact that she is from the very lowest echelons of society that will make her so loved.
sentences.zh: 然而，诡异的是，正是因为她出身于社会的最底层，才会让她如此深受欢迎。

sentences.en: But there's something, sometimes people are ashamed of things and, you know, isn't that so interesting?
sentences.zh: 但有时候，人们会对某些事情感到羞耻，你知道的，这难道不是很奇妙吗？

sentences.en: It is.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And also interesting is that she is going to such lengths to claim the name of Duarte just as she is changing it.
sentences.zh: 同样有趣的是，她竟然大费周章地要去认领杜阿尔特这个姓氏，而就在这时她又要改姓了。

sentences.en: Because of course, with the wedding, she's no longer Ava Duarte.
sentences.zh: 因为毫无疑问，随着婚礼的举行，她不再是埃瓦·杜阿尔特了。

sentences.en: She's Ava Perón.
sentences.zh: 她是埃瓦·庇隆。

sentences.en: Her childhood is not the only thing she wants to erase.
sentences.zh: 她的童年并不是她唯一想要抹去的东西。

sentences.en: In the next few days, after the wedding, after the big rally in the 17th of October, much of the evidence of her acting career is destroyed.
sentences.zh: 在婚礼之后、10月17日的大集会之后的几天里，她演艺生涯的大部分证据都被销毁了。

sentences.en: She gets all the publicity stills from all the radio stations and she destroys them.
sentences.zh: 她收集了各大广播电台的所有宣传剧照并将其销毁。

sentences.en: She goes to the photographers and of course she has Perón's muscle behind her.
sentences.zh: 她找到了摄影师们，当然，背后有庇隆的势力在支持她。

sentences.en: It's the photographers who've taken pictures of her all those years.
sentences.zh: 这些摄影师多年来一直为她拍摄照片。

sentences.en: She asks for the negatives and she destroys them.
sentences.zh: 她索要底片并将其全部销毁。

sentences.en: And that film, La Prodiga, it's shown privately to her and never released.
sentences.zh: 而那部电影《浪子》只为她进行了私人放映，从未公开发行过。

sentences.en: It is clear that from this point onwards, Ava Duarte is dead and the future will belong to Evita Perón, the politician.
sentences.zh: 显然，从这一刻起，埃瓦·杜阿尔特已经死了，而未来将属于政治家埃娃·庇隆。

sentences.en: And that is what we will be looking at in our next episode, which you can hear straight away if you are a member of the Rest of History Club.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们将在下一集探讨的内容，如果你是“历史的其余部分”俱乐部的会员，你可以立刻收听。

sentences.en: If you're not and you would like to hear it, you can go to therestishistory.com and sign up there.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是会员但想听的话，可以访问 therestishistory.com 在那里注册。

sentences.en: And if not, it will be out very soon anyway.
sentences.zh: 如果没注册也没关系，反正这一集很快就会发布。

sentences.en: So that's not good marketing on my part, but it is true.
sentences.zh: 所以这算不上我做得好的营销，但确实是实话。

sentences.en: And we're all about the truth on the Rest of History, unlike Perón and Ava.
sentences.zh: 我们在《历史的其余部分》节目中一向追求真相，这和庇隆与埃瓦可不一样。

sentences.en: And we will see you very soon.
sentences.zh: 我们很快再见。

sentences.en: Bye bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Hasta luego.
sentences.zh: 回头见。
